get_state_of_obj: get the current state value of a named property from a ManagedObject's user-defined metadata
set_state_of_obj: set a named state property value on a ManagedObject's user-defined object_states metadata
create_ObjectStateSpec_subclass: create a subclass of ObjectStateSpec to define a custom object state with update and draw logic
toggle_BooleanObjectState: toggle a BooleanObjectState like is_powered_on or is_clean on a ManagedObject instance
get_snapshot_dict_ObjectStateMachine: get a snapshot dictionary of all tracked object states keyed by state name and object handle
